Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: As assigned by NASDAQ OMX PSX

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime

Field.Name: CheckSum

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Once logged in, the subscriber will need to send only a heartbeat message to keep the session active. Standard FIX session message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. Standard FIX field.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in the Test Request message to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat. Standard FIX field.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: In the event that the sequence numbers are out of synch, the subscriber should send a resend request to retransmit any potentially lost data. Standard FIX session message.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent. Standard FIX field.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent; 0 for infinity. Standard FIX field.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Standard FIX session message (session level reject).

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. Standard FIX field.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced. FIX 4.2 field.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced. FIX 4.2 field.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message. FIX 4.2 field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Message to explain reason for rejection. Standard FIX field.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Standard FIX session message (Gap Fill or Reset).

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. Standard FIX field.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. Standard FIX field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. Standard FIX field.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Subscribers are required to log in to the OUCH DROP application using a standard FIX logon message. When reconnecting, in either NASDAQ OMX PSX's primary or backup data center, the subscriber should re-login to the session using the next transmitted sequence numbers.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not Supported

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds.

Message.Name: ExecutionReport
Message.Description: The Order Acknowledgement, Order Replace, Order Cancel, Execution Report, Rejected Order and Broken Trade messages are all Execution Reports (MsgType = 8), told apart by ExecType (150): 0 = Order Acknowledgement, 5 = Order Replace, 4 = Order Cancel, 1 or 2 = Execution Report, 8 = Rejected Order, and 2 with ExecTransType (20) 1 = Broken Trade. Each OUCH DROP host can be configured to send a message anytime an order is entered, canceled, executed or broken, or any combination of these events.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Account originating the order

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: First 4 characters of the order entry port token

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX sub system/Session identifier. Req'd Y on every table but the Order Acknowledgement, which leaves it blank.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: May be user field, otherwise not present

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client Order ID as specified on the order.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX assigned sequence Number for this order

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: For fill and partial-fill execution reports. ExecID is based on the OUCH match number of the transaction. If you cross yourself on a trade the buy and sell orders will have the same ExecID. For other execution reports this is just a unique id of execution report. Uniqueness guaranteed within the session.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies transaction type: 0 = New; 1 = Cancel on the Broken Trade. Trade breaks will be sent with an ExecTransType of 1. NASDAQ OMX PSX does not support trade corrections.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Describes the Specific Execution Report: 0 = New (Order Acknowledgement), 1 = Partial Fill or 2 = Filled (Execution Report), 2 = Filled (Broken Trade), 4 = Canceled (Order Cancel), 5 = Replaced (Order Replace), 8 = Rejected (Rejected Order)

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Describes the current state of a CHAIN of orders, same scope as OrderQty, CumQty, LeavesQty, and AvgPx. Each table lists the same value as ExecType.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker Symbol

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the trade: 1 = buy order, 2 = sell order, 5 = sell short, subscriber affirms ability to borrow securities in good deliverable form for delivery within three business days, 6 = sell short exempt, subscriber affirms ability to borrow securities in good deliverable form for delivery within three business days

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Shares available

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Remaining shares. Broken Trade: amount of shares open for further execution.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Currently executed shares for chain of orders. "0" on the Order Acknowledgement and Broken Trade.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order. "0" on the Order Acknowledgement and Broken Trade.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: As specified in the NewOrder

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit, 3 = Cross

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = Day, 2 = At the Opening, 3 = Immediate or Cancel, 4 = Fill or Kill, 5 = Good Till Cancel (GTC), 6 = Good Till Date, 7 = At the Close

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string. In case of reject will also contain NASDAQ OMX PSX order reject code. See "Reject Reasons" table.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation (expressed in GMT). This field will now appear on all messages; previously this only appeared on execution or break messages.
